items.headline: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon frontier model
items.summary: Google made its latest frontier model, Gemini 4 Carbon, available to developers, enterprises, scientists, and consumers, touting higher-precision knowledge work, improved agentic coding, and state-of-the-art cybersecurity. The launch intensifies the frontier model race against Anthropic and OpenAI.

items.headline: Google unveils two new specialized AI chips
items.summary: Google broadened its AI hardware portfolio with new chips including the TPU 8i Max, which combines two inference-focused TPU 8i chips to double memory, processing power, and bandwidth. The move helps hyperscalers reduce reliance on Nvidia amid growing compute demands.

items.headline: Google's November Pixel Drop adds Gemini Intelligence
items.summary: Google's November Pixel Drop brought Gemini Intelligence updates to Pixel 10 devices, along with custom widgets and the launch of Pixel Tag. The update deepens on-device AI integration across Google's hardware lineup.

items.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
items.summary: Anthropic unveiled two new frontier models—Fable 5.2 for coding, reasoning and agentic tasks, and the access-restricted Mythos 5.2 for cybersecurity and life-sciences research—paired with a 20% API cost reduction. It marks the company's first frontier release since CEO Dario Amodei called to slow AI development in September.

items.headline: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber for vulnerability research
items.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Cyber, a cybersecurity model designed to find and validate software vulnerabilities. The launch reflects growing competition among AI labs to build specialized security-focused frontier models.

items.headline: OpenAI introduces Images 2.6 with faster generation
items.summary: OpenAI released Images 2.6, offering faster image iteration, more control over editing rounds, GIF animation, and expanded API creation tools. The update strengthens OpenAI's creative tooling against Google and other rivals.
